capabilities: Highlight stylistic patterns in notes: repetitions, hedges, clichés, monotonous sentence lengths, tricolons, and sentence forms
Correct French spelling and grammar with Grammalecte or a local neural model
Normalize French punctuation, non-breaking spaces, apostrophes, and dashes
Look up synonyms, definitions, antonyms, phonetics, rhymes, and quotations in downloadable French dictionaries
Run AI corrections and contextual synonyms via Anthropic, OpenAI, Codex, Claude Code, or a local Ollama server
extras: The README is in French and targets French-language writing only. Core features are free and work offline after downloading dictionaries; AI features are optional and may incur provider costs. Detailed data-format and resource-license docs live in separate linked pages. Beta versions install via BRAT from the tcrouzet/finition repository. The neural engine and the Claude Code integration are described as experimental.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tool for reviewing French writing style — repeated words, clichés, monotony, punctuation rules — beyond basic spellcheck.

relations.evidence: Le modèle public CamemBERT se charge dans les réglages.
Avec Ollama ou un autre serveur compatible OpenAI, renseigner Serveur local
Claude Code peut aussi servir aux corrections et synonymes, avec son installation native déjà connectée.
Sur ordinateur, si Codex CLI est détecté, Codex apparaît dans Modèle par défaut
BRAT sert à tester les versions bêta

requires.name: Anthropic or OpenAI secret for cloud AI corrections
Codex CLI or Claude Code for those AI backends

summary: French prose checker that highlights repetitions, clichés, and sentence-rhythm patterns, corrects grammar and punctuation, and provides French dictionaries.
